name: Final Spell
source:
The Supernatural doesn't wait for anyone to believe or understand the power of the dark arts.
When the dark forces call, there's no ignore button. If your time has come, there's no place you can run to try and hide.
So, you think you're ready for this adventure? It doesn't matter!
translation:
超自然现象不会等待任何人相信或理解黑暗艺术的力量。
当黑暗势力召唤时，没有忽略按钮。如果你的时间到了，你就无处可躲。
那么，你认为你已经准备好开始这次冒险了吗？没关系！
